topics.text: Located halfway up Mogan Mountain, the guesthouse offers stunning views of bamboo forests. It's ideal for hiking and stargazing, providing a peaceful retreat from city life.
Warm, attentive service by owners and staff. Hosts offer local recommendations and assist with special requests, ensuring guests feel at home.
Modern amenities with clean rooms, some with balconies. Includes a pool, courtyard, and communal areas. Offers Dyson hair dryers and quality toiletries.
Freshness and variety praised, accommodating dietary preferences.

address: No. 6, Mawuli, Miaoqian Village, Moganshan Town, Deqing, Zhejiang, China
